english.title: Driver of hackney carriage demand / take more than proper fare / refuse to carry person / reasonable quantity of luggage
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the driver of a hackney carriage namely, **(..SPECIFY VRN AND MAKE..),

(A)_[demanded more than the proper fare]_
(B)_[took more than the proper fare]_
(C)_[refused to admit and carry in that carriage the number of persons painted or marked on the carriage or specified in the certificate granted by the Transport for London in respect of it]_
(D)_[refused to carry by the carriage a reasonable quantity of luggage for a person who hired or intended to hire the carriage]_
(E)_[**(..SPECIFY COMBINATION OF ABOVE..)]_

in that **(..SPECIFY PARTICULARS OF OFFENCE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 17(1) of London Hackney Carriage Act 1853.
